review.scope: Fresh review before authorized P001 admission-only input preflight. Operator approved a94d886 packet and exact selection; no launch/new-backend transfer. Inspect sampling, frozen runner calls, archive/member integrity, nonmaterializing headers, private evidence, runtime reconciliation, time/capacity bounds. Source-only, no patient execution.
findings: Verified (source): identity bindings are correct and fail-closed. RUNNER_SHA d54e3ea5… equals the operator-ratified hash for campaigns/isles24-pilot/experiments/P001/run.py recorded in prediction_selection.json; ARCHIVE_SIZE/ARCHIVE_MD5 match the frozen runner's own constants; numpy 2.3.3/nibabel 5.3.2 pins match the recorded decoder-check environment. All approval/source/environment/archive/attempt checks precede any archive byte access, and each mismatch raises before the attempt directory exists, leaving no partial state.

Verified (source): sampling is admission-only and deterministic. admission_members takes only pair['tmax'], enforces relative ses-01 *_tmax.nii.gz paths, 99 unique members, and eligible[:1] selects the first lexical case ID with no outcome input, matching the receipt's selection_rule and admission_members_checked=1. Label and reserved members never reach the 7z argument list, verify_file, or nibabel; only one member is extracted, so no whole-archive extraction occurs.

Verified (source): frozen runner use is read-only and preserves scientific approvals. The runner is loaded under module name 'frozen_p001_preflight' so its __main__ block never executes; only selection() and verify_file() are called; predict/metrics/run and verify_decision are never invoked; no frozen bytes or the strict >6.0 threshold are touched. selection() re-verifies cohort SHA-256 and member-manifest git-blob identity from the digest-pinned checkout before any member is chosen.

Verified (source + synthetic test read, not executed): header access is nonmaterializing. header_record reads only dataobj.slope/inter, shape, get_data_dtype and xyzt_units, with finiteness/3D checks; the test poisons ArrayProxy.__array__ and Nifti1Image.get_fdata to enforce this. Receipt's unit_semantics correctly disclaims that header evidence alone establishes derivative units, consistent with the decision packet.

Verified (source): privacy boundaries hold. Case IDs, member paths, 7z console output, and exception text are written only to attempt-private files (binding.json, admission_headers.private.json, extraction.console.log, failure.private.txt) under umask 0o077 in a 0700 directory with exclusive-create opens; stdout carries only aggregate fields, headers file hash, and fixed PREFLIGHT_*/AUTHORIZED_CPU_* codes, with any other message replaced by PRIVATE_DIAGNOSTIC_REQUIRED.

Verified (source): runtime reconciliation and recovery semantics are fail-closed. Any matching /proc cmdline, any existing execution/.private/.worker path, or incomplete process visibility yields a HOLD disposition that refuses the preflight; disposition wording avoids claiming global nonexecution and the observation is preserved in binding.json. Fresh-attempt requirement plus open('x') everywhere prevents overwriting; there are no automatic retries; TimeoutError and subprocess timeout (which kills the child) are caught with receipt and private failure evidence retained.

Verified (source): time and capacity bounds are enforced. The 5400 s monotonic budget covers archive MD5 hashing (checked per 8 MiB block), extraction (timeout=max(1, remaining)), and per-member verification; disk_usage is checked on the attempt parent (the extraction filesystem) for the selected member size plus 512 MiB before any write. Full-archive size+MD5 match against the pinned identity, combined with the identity-verified member manifest and per-member size/CRC via the unchanged verify_file, supports the INPUT_INTEGRITY_AND_HEADERS_VERIFIED claim.

Suggestion (untested, fail-safe direction): the CPU-runtime guard `shutil.which('nvidia-smi')` can be truthy on Colab CPU images where the binary exists without an attached GPU, causing a false AUTHORIZED_CPU_COLAB_REQUIRED refusal. Consequence: possible spurious refusal, never unsafe execution. Affected task: running the preflight on the authorized runtime. Smallest correction if it fires: check for an actual device (e.g., /proc/driver/nvidia presence or `nvidia-smi -L` exit status) instead of binary presence; do not weaken the COLAB_RELEASE_TAG requirement.

Suggestion (inferred): reconcile_runtime's cmdline patterns hardcode 'P001-v1.worker/launch.py' while the path-existence check derives from --execution-root; a worker started under a differently named root is caught only by the path check, not the process scan. The docstring honestly documents incomplete visibility, and unreadable /proc entries already force HOLD. Smallest correction: additionally derive a cmdline substring from execution_root.name.

Suggestion (inferred edge case): if an exception escapes run() after binding.json exists (e.g., failure.private.txt or receipt.json write fails on a full disk), main reports status REFUSED_BEFORE_ATTEMPT even though the attempt directory was created with a STARTED binding; the printed label contradicts on-disk evidence. Evidence is still preserved and exit code is nonzero. Smallest correction: use a distinct failure status (e.g., ATTEMPT_EVIDENCE_WRITE_FAILED) when a.attempt exists.

Verification note (source-only limit): APPROVAL_SHA 56fa21d4… does not match any artifact hash recorded in the supplied packet; this is expected if it pins campaigns/isles24-pilot/prediction_selection.json itself (which cannot contain its own hash), but this review cannot confirm which file it binds. A wrong pin fails closed (PREFLIGHT_OPERATOR_BINDING). Smallest correction: document the expected --approval artifact path and its hash provenance in the script docstring or the implementation note before use.

Verification note (untested dependency): importing the frozen runner executes its top-level `from orchestrator.campaign import verify_decision, sha`; orchestrator/campaign.py was not supplied, so import-time side effects are unverified. Risk is low (verify_decision is imported, not called; the checkout is the digest-pinned frozen one), but the import surface is part of what runs during the preflight.

Process note: this is a source-only review; the synthetic tests in tests/test_p001_input_preflight.py were read and their assertions are consistent with the implementation, but they were not executed here and no patient data or archive bytes were touched.
